title: Density of blow-up limits (Simon 7.3.1 proof (1)–(4)): μ_C(B_ρ(0)) = ω_nρⁿΘ for every ρ
statement: Let P ∈ ℕ, n ≥ 1, U ⊆ ℝ^P open, x ∈ U, T ∈ 𝒟_n(U) and C ∈ 𝒟_n(ℝ^P) both integer multiplicity, θ ∈ ℝ with HasMassDensity T x θ, and λ_j > 0 with λ_j → 0 such that μ_{η_{x,λ_j#}T} → μ_C for all integer multiplicity representations (MassMeasuresConverge (fun j ↦ blowUp T x λ_j) C). Then M_{B_ρ(0)}(C) = ω_n·ρⁿ·θ for every ρ > 0 (ω_n = unitBallVolume n; in [0, ∞] as unitBallVolume n · ofReal(ρⁿ) · ofReal θ), and HasMassDensity C 0 θ.
lean_statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (U : Set (Euclid P)) (T : GeometricCurrentOn U n) (C : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) n) (x : Euclid P) (θ : ℝ) (lams : ℕ → ℝ) (hlams : ∀ j, 0 < lams j), IsOpen U → 0 < n → x ∈ U → IsIntegerMultiplicity T → IsIntegerMultiplicity C → Tendsto lams atTop (𝓝 0) → HasMassDensity T x θ → MassMeasuresConverge (fun j => blowUp T x (lams j) (hlams j).ne') C → (∀ ρ : ℝ, 0 < ρ → C.massOn (ball 0 ρ) = unitBallVolume n * ENNReal.ofReal (ρ ^ n) * ENNReal.ofReal θ) ∧ HasMassDensity C 0 θ
